name: DISABLE RESTORE

name: HIDE TASKBAR TASK VIEW ICON
description: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'ShowTaskViewButton' -ErrorAction Stop).ShowTaskViewButton; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE NUM LOCK ON STARTUP
description: Turns on Num Lock automatically when Windows starts.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Keyboard' -Name 'InitialKeyboardIndicators' -ErrorAction Stop).InitialKeyboardIndicators; if ($v -eq '2') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE SCROLLBARS ALWAYS VISIBLE
description: Shows scrollbars permanently instead of hiding them when not active.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility' -Name 'DynamicScrollbars' -ErrorAction Stop).DynamicScrollbars; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE STICKY KEYS
description: Disables Sticky Keys popup that appears when pressing Shift repeatedly.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys' -Name 'Flags' -ErrorAction Stop).Flags; if ($v -eq '506') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE BATTERY PERCENTAGE
description: Shows battery percentage in the system tray icon.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer' -Name 'ShowBatteryPercentage' -ErrorAction Stop).ShowBatteryPercentage; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"
